It looks like my phone currently can't send MMS messages, and it also shows that there's no cellular service and the SIM card status is "missing." I’m also not connected to Wi-Fi right now. 

What should I do next?

I removed and reinserted the SIM card as you suggested. Now my phone recognizes the SIM card, and I have a poor signal on a 2G network. However, mobile data is still disabled, and I’m not connected to Wi-Fi.

What should I do next?
I’ve turned on mobile data, but my phone is still connected to a 2G network with a poor signal. What would you like me to do next?

What should I try next?

I just tried sending an MMS message, but it still isn’t working. My messaging app still can’t send MMS messages. There’s no specific error message, it just doesn’t go through.

What should I do next?
I checked my APN settings, and it looks like the MMSC URL for picture messages is not set. What should I do to fix this?

I reset my APN settings to default and restarted my phone, but I still can’t send MMS messages. The issue is still happening—my messaging app can’t send MMS.

Is there anything else I should try?

I checked and Wi-Fi Calling was enabled, so I turned it off and tried sending an MMS again, but it still didn’t work. My messaging app still can’t send MMS messages.

Should I check the app permissions next? If so, which permissions should I look for specifically?

I checked my messaging app’s permissions. It has permission for SMS and phone, but it doesn’t have storage permission.

Should I go ahead and enable storage permission for the messaging app?

I enabled storage permission for the messaging app and tried sending an MMS again, but it still isn’t working. The app still can’t send MMS messages.

Is there anything else I should try?
